body_html:
The Newland Round Table brings people together without crowding the room. Its clean 36" round top and sculpted steel X-base suit casual meetings, focused solo work, or a quick catch-up over coffee — a versatile anchor for collaborative and multi-purpose spaces. Built in Canada by Global Furniture Group, it is engineered for the everyday demands of busy institutional environments.

Features

  • 36" round one-piece top in 1" thick thermally fused laminate with a matching 2mm edge
  • Sturdy steel X-base with a 2.5" square centre post and 1" x 2" rectangular tube feet
  • X-base painted in a durable sandtex finish with matching plastic end caps
  • Factory-installed inserts provide a solid metal-to-metal connection between top and base
  • Adjustable levelling glides included for stability on uneven floors
  • X-base finishes: Black, Designer White, or Tungsten; laminate top available in all Newland finishes
  • Also available at 22"H coffee-table height and 42"H standing/bar height to coordinate across a space
  • Ships easy to assemble in two cartons

Specifications

Overall 36"W x 36"D x 29"H at standard seated height, weighing 56 lbs. Meets all applicable ANSI/BIFMA standards and carries GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold certification for low chemical emissions. Made in Canada and backed by a 15-year warranty, with 5 years on moving and electrical parts.
